messages:
Sara M.: Quick RFC follow-up: propose exposing per-layer cold_start_score so coordinator can prioritize prefetches across tenants.
Liam: How do we compute the score?
Sara M.: cold_start_score = a*est_access_rate + b*mem_pressure + c*recompute_cost; weights tunable per-model. Coordinator sums layer scores and picks top-N under budget.
Dmitri: Telemetry burden is the main worry if we pull per-layer stats for many models.
Meera: Keep loader surface minimal. Suggest SummarizeLayers(model_id, layer_ids) -> summaries with est_access_rate, est_size, variant_tag. Coordinator computes scores.
Tony: Or have loaders return precomputed layer_score + provenance to cut RPCs, but that needs loader upgrades.
warmup-bot: Reminder: keep warmup RPC p50 < 1ms to avoid SLO regressions. :warning:
Liam: Hybrid pattern: loaders return coarse per-chunk summaries; coordinator requests LayerDetail for top candidates.
Dmitri: Proto sketch: service WarmupService { rpc SummarizeLayers(SummarizeRequest) returns (SummarizeResponse); rpc LayerDetail(LayerDetailRequest) returns (LayerDetailResponse); } messages: SummarizeResponse has LayerSummary entries (layer_id, est_access_rate, est_size, variant_tag).
Meera: Add schema_version header and optional provenance so coordinator can fallback on older loaders.
Tony: Include variant multipliers for quantized/fused kernels since size and recompute_cost differ.
Sara M.: Operational notes: sample summaries (1-5%) to cut load; coordinator fallback if timeouts: pick highest-parameter layers and apply prefix KV caching; emit metrics.
Liam: I'll run perf probes on staging for SummarizeLayers latency at scale.
Dmitri: I'll add fallback metrics/dashboard.
Meera: Who will draft the small RFC PR? Keep it opt-in for loaders.
Sara M.: I'll open a PR with proto, coordinator scoring pseudocode, simulation results and unit test ideas.
Tony: I'll add variant multiplier table and review.
warmup-bot: Task created WARMUP-2138 (layer-score-summary-rfc).
Sara M.: Note: avoid marketing phrases like "prefetch bidding" in the PR.
Meera: :thumbsup:
